_comment: DEMO-SAFE seed for LESNAR AI. No real drones, no PX4/Gazebo, no flight. Registers SIMULATED drones via the real backend API so the dashboard, telemetry, and audit reflect a real state change. Coordinates are public Nairobi-area points for visual context only.
notes: Run scripts/run_lesnarai_demo_safe.sh to seed. This exercises POST /api/drones -> fleet + DB + audit, visible in GET /api/drones, GET /api/telemetry, and the operator dashboard map.
